{{Top}}
{{Quote|A busted fuel line, dented warp vortex stabilizers, and a giant hole in the aft hydraulics. All because you had to fly her into a war zone.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Rebel Force: Firefight">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>}}
A '''vortex stabilizer''' was a component that could be found aboard many, if not all [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. These parts were not typically serviceable by crews in the field; thus if a vessel's vortex stabilizer became inoperable, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] would be forced to put into a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] for repair or replacement.
